name: codex-naming-studio
description: A Codex naming workbench that opens in the built-in browser, hands GUI requests to Codex through a project state file, and renders structured name analysis back without any API key.

interface.shortDescription: Collect naming constraints and let Codex return structured name analysis.
interface.longDescription: Codex Naming Studio opens a local naming workbench in the Codex built-in browser. Users fill baby naming constraints and click generate; Codex picks up the request from the project state file, runs bazi and research steps per the derived plan, and writes ranked Chinese name candidates with scoring, five-elements analysis, source notes, and comparison cards back to the GUI. No API key required.
defaultPrompt: Open the Codex Naming Studio workbench for this project.
Handle the pending Naming Studio request and write results back to the GUI.
